summary: A tagged turn now shows Nora the last 20 messages of the room instead of 40, so each model call carries a smaller prompt.
details: A reply to a message further back than 20 still shows that message, and still reads past the old window to find it.
Who-said lookups still search the last 40 messages.
The depth is the new `[store] prompt_window` key (default 20, never above `context_window`).
limitations: Casual references to something said 21 to 40 messages ago are no longer in front of her unless she loads the transcript.
